# Toast
A brief, transient message that confirms an action or reports a result without interrupting the task. It appears out of flow at the edge of the screen and dismisses itself.

USE WHEN
• Confirming a completed action ("Link copied", "Changes saved")
• Reporting a background result the user did not wait for (upload finished, sync failed)
• Offering a short undo for a reversible action (Action button)

DON'T USE WHEN
• The message must persist or needs a decision - use Alert (in flow) or Dialog
• The content is long, rich or interactive beyond one action
• The user must not miss it (blocking errors) - show inline

DO
• Keep the title to one line and the description to one or two short lines; sentence case
• Use success or danger only when the outcome is that status; default is neutral
• Give every toast a Close button unless it auto-dismisses and has no action

DON'T
• Stack more than three toasts
• Put critical information only in a toast
• Use Action for anything other than one short verb (Undo, Retry, View)

PROPERTIES
Variant: default | success | danger
Icon, Title, Description, Action, Close: booleans (Icon off, Action off by default)
Title text, Description text: strings. Action label is edited on the nested Button.

TOKENS
Fill surface-raised (success-subtle, danger-subtle); border border (success-muted, danger-muted) at border-width/1; radius/2xl; padding spacing/4; gap spacing/3, content gap spacing/1; shadow/lg; title font-size/sm medium foreground; description font-size/xs foreground-muted; width 400 (content-width-md); layer z-toast (code only)
